image_description: A side-profile view of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near a coral reef. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a golden-yellow posterior body and tail with a distinct black margin. The background consists of textured red and green corals and rocky substrate.
